name: Muscle and Pony Car
summary: The young, fast American coupe. A long bonnet, a short rear deck and a fastback or notch roof. It has a bold stripe, a bonnet scoop, vinyl bucket seats and a woodgrain dash.

philosophy.core_thesis: A fast car is for the young and must cost little. It has a long bonnet over a big engine, a short tail and a few bold marks, on a small base.
design_principles: Make the bonnet long and the rear deck short, with the cabin set well back.
Keep the body compact, 4.6 to 4.9 m long, and the roof about 1.3 m high.
Fit a grille with a galloping horse, a bull or a bar, and set the headlamps wide apart.
Add bold marks: a racing stripe, a bonnet scoop, a rear spoiler or side stripes.
Show the engine size on the wing, in chrome numerals or a badge.
Trim the cabin with vinyl bucket seats, a bench or a console, and a woodgrain-effect dashboard.
Offer many options so that each buyer builds a car to his own taste.
anti_patterns: Dull body colours with no stripe
A body that is soft and round

silhouette.shape: A long-bonnet, short-deck coupe: a low body with a flat bonnet, a roof that sits back and a tail that rises in a short kick.
silhouette.line: A body line that rises slightly from the front wheel to the rear wing. A bold curve over the rear wheel is known as the hip.
silhouette.fit: Four seats, but the rear seats are tight; the front bucket seats sit low and close to the wheel.
silhouette.proportion: Length 4.6 to 4.9 m; height 1.3 m; the bonnet is about 40 percent of the length; the rear deck about 15 percent.
rules: Show the long bonnet with a scoop, a bulge or a wide stripe.
Set a small round or square lamp in each end of the grille.
Give the rear wing a strong hip line over a wide tyre.
Set the tail lamps in three vertical bars or in a full-width panel.

fabrics.rule: Use cheap, strong, mass-made materials with a bold look: stamped steel, vinyl, chrome and moulded plastic, with paint and tape for the colour.

methods: unitised steel body stamped in big presses
full-size clay model by the styling studio
chrome plated front and rear bumpers
vinyl bucket seats cut and sewn on a line
paint stripes and decals applied by tape
construction.closures: Chrome push-button door handles, a flip-open fuel cap on the tail, and a hood pin or a lock on the bonnet.
construction.details: A bonnet scoop, a racing stripe, wide tyres with white letters, a chrome engine badge, a floor shifter and a round dial cluster.

surface.pattern: A bold stripe over the bonnet and roof, or along the sill; a woodgrain-effect dashboard and a plain or houndstooth seat insert.
surface.gloss: Acrylic enamel paint at 80–90 GU; chrome at more than 90 GU; vinyl at 10–25 GU.
surface.wear: Rust in the wing, cracked dash vinyl and peeled stripes; owners restore the car to the factory stripe.

palette.strategy: Strong, saturated colours, with a black or white stripe, a black interior and chrome in the grille and the bumpers.

processes: clay model by a styling team
making.scale: Mass-made by the big firms, up to several hundred thousand cars a year; one body offered with many engines and trims.
making.signs: A long bonnet, a short deck, a bold stripe, a scoop, wide tyres and a vinyl bucket-seat cabin with a woodgrain dash.

pieces.form: Two-door fastback coupe with a long bonnet and a short deck
Compact hardtop with a bonnet scoop and a stripe
Low vinyl bucket seats with a pleated insert
Moulded dash with a woodgrain panel and round dials
Slotted steel wheel with a chrome ring and a wide tyre
Chrome bumpers and a grille with a galloping emblem

emotion.target_response: A rush of power and youth: the viewer sees a long bonnet, a loud colour and a car that costs little and goes fast.

use_cases: a 1960s road movie or a drag race scene
a poster for a car show
an image prompt for an American coupe
avoid_when: the brief wants a refined or a luxury car
the brief wants a small European car
the brief wants a quiet, electric car

modifiers.how: Flatten the panels, lower the nose, raise the tail and replace the chrome with black trim.
Add fins, a full-width chrome grille, two-tone paint and a wrap-around screen.

ornament_level.note: The stripe, the scoop and the badge carry the ornament; the body stays plain.
